articles.title: Natura’s $99 smart ring puts AI agents on your finger
articles.description: Natura’s $99 Interface smart ring lets you summon AI agents with the press of a finger to complete tasks, capture thoughts, and control devices — while doubling as a health tracker.
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
articles.description: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, though ordinary frustration and criticism are still allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: Google releases a new local-first Granola competitor
articles.description: Google’s new AI Edge Foresight app takes on Granola with an offline meeting note-taker that can transcribe conversations, generate notes, and answer questions using on-device AI.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months
articles.description: The company behind the popular LMArena leaderboard has raised $200 million led by Lightspeed and Khosla, and is now measuring AI models on alignment issues such as lying.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Pretend you’re sitting at Elizabeth Holmes’ desk on this weirdly detailed website
articles.description: With over a thousand emails, slides, texts, and documents from the United States v. Elizabeth Holmes trial, Extend engineer Bo Lau created a website that simulates what it might have been like to rifle through the Theranos founder's desk.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
articles.description: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute allegations of mishandling sensitive information, warning in an open letter that their dismissals are creating a chilling effect on the company’s AI safety culture.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Ben Affleck is an AI nerd, and the internet is impressed
articles.description: Ben Affleck is going viral for his deep knowledge of AI, from neural networks and transformers to open weights. The actor, who sold his AI filmmaking startup to Netflix earlier this year, is proving he's more than just a Hollywood star.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
articles.description: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
articles.description: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: OpenAI’s math solutions aren’t meeting the field’s standards yet
articles.description: OpenAI's flood of proofs deviated from the guidelines set by a group of mathematical researchers consulted by the frontier lab.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz
